integrity.audit_limits: Originality is best-knowledge only; mathematical review in these files is not independent external validation.
integrity.proof_limits: The finite experiments independently corroborate but do not prove all prime powers; no claim of computer-formalized infinite certification.
integrity.result: A self-contained proof, exact Hasse–Wronskian multiplicity argument and reproducing finite-field program are included.

limitations: Applies to the hyperplane series on the specific smooth Fermat curve of degree d=q^2+q+1 over characteristic p with q a p-power, not to other plane series or arbitrary cyclic covers. Historical priority may be affected by an unindexed equivalent calculation. No independent review has occurred.
title: The complete tangent-contact and ramification divisor of the Fermat norm curve
